verdict.rationale: PayPal's docs name catalog partners (Wix, Cymbio, BigCommerce/Feedonomics, Shopware) that connect to its agentic commerce services. PayPal also plugs into third-party protocols: OpenAI's ACP for ChatGPT and Google's UCP for AI Mode/Gemini. That points to a multi-party ecosystem rather than a private integration, but all of it is vendor-claimed, and PayPal's own cart API and Store Sync remain PayPal-hosted and form-gated. missing for 10: independent evidence that partners actually implement the platform, documentation of how deep those partner integrations go, and evidence that PayPal's own cart/Store Sync interface is an open protocol others can implement.

support.subject: As a developer, at least two independent parties beyond the vendor implement the protocol or platform — it is an ecosystem, not a private integration

citations.quote: Connect your product listings to PayPal's partners like Wix, Cymbio, Commerce (BigCommerce & Feedonomics), and Shopware to make your products easy for customers to find and buy.
accept payments from AI shopping assistants across major platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Gemini, without building separate integrations for each.
